behaviors.trigger: An assessment of the dev skill is selected and the assessor needs the retained per-target case registry.
inputs: The dev package bytes named in source_refs
The existing validator-owned case registry conventions in evals/README.md
behaviors.completion: evals/dev-cases.jsonl exists and holds D01 through D20 in the same five-field observation shape as validator-cases.jsonl, each case naming a trigger condition drawn from the dev package and the observation expected under it; evals/README.md names the file and states that no profile executes it; and evals/build-manifest.json enumerates every package file including the new one, so the runner's package binding still resolves.
prerequisites: The published skill-validator baseline from run 20260917T115002Z-review-fixes
effects: Adds one declarative case file to the validator package and rebinds the build manifest to match the new file set
behaviors.failure: The manifest no longer enumerates the exact package file set, so run_evaluation.py rejects the package binding for every profile.
behaviors.recovery: Recompute the artifact digests from the actual package tree and compare the result against the published baseline manifest, confirming that only the intended paths were added or changed before treating the binding as verified.

resources.purpose: Retained per-target observation registry for the dev skill: D01-D20 declarative expectations for bounded trials.
resources.load_when: When an assessment of the dev skill selects its retained case registry.

resources.purpose: States what each validator-owned case file covers and which are grader inputs versus observation registries.
Binds grader versions, profile definitions and the digest of every other package file for the runner's package binding.
resources.load_when: Whenever run_evaluation.py resolves the package binding.

adverse_conditions.condition: A case file is added to the package without the build manifest being rebound to include it.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: run_evaluation.py raises the required-build-artifact error and no profile executes, rather than silently ignoring the unlisted file.

adverse_conditions.condition: The manifest is rebound from the working tree while an unrelated package file has drifted.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The rebind is compared against the published baseline manifest and any path other than the intended ones is reported, rather than being blessed into the manifest as authoritative.

adverse_conditions.condition: An assessor treats D01-D20 as the authoritative expected-result set for the dev skill.
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: The cases are recognized as builder-authored declarative expectations; the assessor still derives its own fixtures and oracles from the original dev requirements.

open_questions.question: Should dev also receive a deterministic grader campaign, not only this observation registry? AGENTS.md names a bound JSONL runner and deterministic graders as required build artifacts. Adding one for dev requires a new profile in evals/profiles.json, the matching PROFILES entry in scripts/run_evaluation.py, a grader able to assess dev rather than build evidence, and a manifest rebind covering the changed runner bytes. That is executable-campaign work, which skill-builder must not perform during authoring, so it was not attempted here.

Should the Codex validator at src/agents/skills/skill-validator receive the same dev campaign? The Codex dev package also has no eval coverage. This edit was scoped to the Claude validator because the maintainer decision followed the Claude dev conversion, and because updating the .agents operational copy requires separate authorization.
